name: hype-me
description: Help people find your game and stay: where players come from, where to promote, how similar games took off, who is talking about you, promo plans with a viral-loop check, bugs and first-time-player UX problems found fast, retention and aha moments, and an experiment loop with cheap prototypes. For indie games and small projects on web, Steam/itch.io and mobile. Never posts or spends without your yes.
